summary.content:
Today's selection covers 78 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 49 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Why Irregular’s A.I. Tests for Meta, Anthropic and OpenAI Went Off the Rails
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Hackers now exploit critical Gitea flaw in code injection attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, BBC Technology, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 48 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: Why Irregular’s A.I. Tests for Meta, Anthropic and OpenAI Went Off the Rails
top.description: Irregular, an Israeli start-up, worked with OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta to assess the security of their A.I. models. It made a mistake. Then the tests went off the rails.

top.title: Robot brain builders are pushing out of their GPT-2 era
top.description: Robot bodies are waiting for their AI brains to catch up.

top.title: QueryStory wants you to believe what AI is telling you
top.description: The startup came out of stealth with $6 million in seed funding and a plan to use LLMs and cybersecurity know-how to make AI queries coherent.

top.title: Finding Nemo(Claw): Networking Issue Allows for LLM Poisoning in OpenClaw
top.description: Attackers can exploit a security bug in Nvidia's tool to gain unauthenticated access to the local model server through the Ollama API, paving the way for persistent AI agent corruption.

top.title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec as stream of high-profile departures continues
top.description: In a statement to TechCrunch about Malone's departure, OpenAI said it had "recently reorganized" its "infrastructure organization to support the scale and pace of our work."

top.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
top.description: Anthropic is giving Claude a shared memory across chat and Cowork, so users no longer have to repeatedly brief the AI on projects, preferences, and other context.
